info.name: PeopleCore HRMS API
info.description:
PeopleCore HRMS — Express + node:sqlite API.

Designed to run against a freshly seeded database: `npm run test:postman` boots the app on a private port with its own database, waits for /api/health and then runs this collection with newman. All values in the environment template are synthetic demo data (see the README); the session is an HttpOnly cookie, but the login response also returns the opaque token so tooling can use `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`.

Flows covered: health → admin login → employee list/create/update → duplicate 409 → validation 422/400 → departments → attendance → leave approve/reject workflow → RBAC 403 probes → audit + reports → cleanup → logout.
